overview.problemStatement: Let $a,K\geq 1$. Does there exist $f(a,K)$ such that if\[a=a_1 f(a,K)$ and with bounded gaps $a_{i+1}-a_i\leq K$ then there are two distinct intervals $I$ and $J$ such that\[\sum_{i\in I}a_i=\sum_{j\in J}a_j?\] Hegyvári [He86] has proved the answer is yes, and gives an explicit bound of the shape\[f(a,K) \ll ae^{O(K)}.\]Hegyvári believes that the exponential dependence on $K$ here is not best possible.
